data.body:
[P2] Preserve request bindings when collection time expires

If a completed read batch discovers a new native request's `WRAPPER_ENTER` and a later batch exhausts the budget, this branch caches the records but exits before `_bind_requests()`. The evidence builder then records an unbound-launch `collectionErrors` entry. The coordinator treats that retained error as a cleanup failure even if retirement subsequently binds and drains the request, leaving the target fenced. Safely reconcile completed streams or retain unfinished bindings as pending collection. Add a regression covering a newly discovered request, budget exhaustion, and subsequent successful retirement.
